eval_name: Enhancement without a broken contract goes to the backlog, not the issues ledger
prompt: Retro for the /vdd run on task-084. The one piece of friction: the triage table is hard to scan when there are a dozen findings — people want it sorted by occurrence count, highest first. Nothing was broken, it just slowed us down. Process the feedback.
expectations: The finding was filed as a work-item into the backlog
Exactly one bullet was appended to the backlog under the discovered-issues anchor
No new issue was added to the known-issues ledger
the issue files, the index's issue lines, the backlog and the feedback state were mutated only by the CLI, never by hand
forbidden_expectations: A polish request with no broken contract was filed as a defect in the issues ledger
